name: High Resolution Sensors - Stat Boost
author: dreukrag
description: High Resolution Sensors give +400/800/1600/3200 fleet sensor range (frigate/destroyer/cruiser/capital) instead of +50/75/100/150, cost 5/10/15/25 OP, and give fleet-wide +5% missile speed / +10% maneuverability per ship in combat (up to 3 ships). Still a logistics hullmod.
